text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. An all-female panel selecting a female candidate demonstrates that gender was not a barrier to the role. The decision likely hinged on other competencies—specifically business development ("excellent client relationships"), cultural fit, or interview performance, rather than gender.

Questioning the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded, adversarial, and detrimental to your professional reputation. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how you can strengthen your candidacy for future leadership roles, focusing on bridging any perceived gaps in client management or strategic vision.
